title: Which album has songs that average 5.57 minutes?
description: Three dot plots show the lengths in minutes of the songs of three albums, and one album has a mean of five point five seven minutes. The video reads the song lengths of one album from its dot plot, adds them, divides by the count and checks the result.
teaching_notes: One idea: the mean uses every song, so read every dot of the plot, add them and divide by how many there are. Watch for students who pick the tallest stack of dots and call that length the mean.

source: Figure it Out (mean and median, question 4)
video_script.why: The child must test the mean claim against a dot plot, by reading every dot, adding and dividing.
video_script.substitution: Read the song lengths from the dots of an album, add them, divide by the number of songs, and compare with the claimed mean.
video_script.anchor: three dot plots, one for each of the albums A, B and C, on a number line from 0 to 7.5 minutes
hold_back: Answer: Album A has a mean of 5.57 minutes
never_show: the answer line before the answer beat
maths_rules: album A has 7 songs: 5, 5, 5.25, 5.5, 5.75, 6 and 6.5 minutes
mean = 39 / 7 = 5.571... = 5.57 minutes to two decimal places
video_script.design: One idea: read every dot, add and divide. The dot plot of album A stays from ground to the end of the idea part.
open_questions: The dot positions of album A come from the worklist; the book figures for albums B and C are not in the extracted text, so the video does not compare them.
